reviews.author: Randy Coleman
reviews.text: After waiting on my roofer I've had for years I called Eric. He got back with me the same day not only with a phone call but an estimate. Within a week the roof was on. I now have a new roofer! The price was reasonable and the service was exceptional, including trimming back some tree that over time would have caused damage to the new roof! I recommend Eric and his company 5 stars!

heuristicReferent.rationale: Heuristic signal from described-action, described-sequence, described-outcome, named-team-member

referentJudgment.rationale: Specific residential roof replacement: same-day call plus estimate, new roof installed within a week, tree trimmed with the job, reasonable price. Names Eric. Concrete job plus outcome.

reviews.author: Val Packard
reviews.text: If you're looking for an honest roofing company, I highly recommend Kingdom Roofing. Eric came out quickly to inspect everything and was professional, efficient, and incredibly knowledgeable… he wasn't looking to sell me something I didn't need and was upfront that repairs weren't necessary.

heuristicReferent.rationale: Heuristic signal from described-action, described-outcome, named-team-member

referentJudgment.rationale: Named inspection visit by Eric with a concrete outcome: repairs were not necessary and he declined to sell unneeded work.

reviews.author: Juell Brandt
reviews.text: My mobile home has had a leaky roof since we got it in 2020… Kingdom Roofing came up from Joplin and gave me a very good solution & quote, much cheaper than having a second roof put on… No leaks, sound-proof!

referentJudgment.rationale: Specific mobile-home leak since 2020; Joplin crew quoted a cheaper alternative to a second roof in the $12,000–14,000 range noted on the listing chip; outcome is no leaks and sound-proof.

reviews.listingNotes: GBP listing also tagged this review with a mobile-home roof quote of $12,000–14,000. That range is a listing tag, not additional review text.

reviews.text: Kingdom Roofing responded immediately to my request for a quote on my roof. Most other roofing companies wouldn't even show up… The best part, no more leaks!
